reviews.author: Mikayla Kim
reviews.text: My mom and I were in Insa-dong and went to see the beautiful hanbok on display at a store. My mom said this is the best hanbok designer in Korea. Imagine my surprise when the designer himself was in the store (it was like meeting Vera Wang)! Mr. Park was really kind and made sure to help us while my mom was tying her scarf. The store sells scarves in a variety of patterns and silk materials. After talking with my mom for a while, Mr. Park asked me to go up to the second floor to see other hanbok and then look at the stairs. When you come to the store, be sure to look at the stairs. You can see celebrities who met their mother wearing her mother’s hanbok. You can see Britney, BTS, and many other K-pop stars here. Hanbok is beautifully crafted in a variety of colors and is a great way to see a part of traditional Korean culture. I was able to take a lot of pictures with her, and it was so fun to see her paying attention to the use of filters and trying out different poses. When we visited, other people also came into the store, and we were surprised to see that Mr. Park is a celebrity and often appears on TV. Mr. Park is really friendly, so it would be nice to talk to him and visit the store to see the beautiful hanbok.

reviews.author: Jules D
reviews.text: I stopped by Mrs. Park’s hanbok store today, and she happened to be there! It was a really nice surprise! I never thought that someone who has been famous as a hanbok craftsman for a long time and as a TV broadcaster would run a store himself! Mrs. Park was really kind, and while I enjoyed looking at the beautiful Hanbok and Korean handicrafts, I also enjoyed chatting with her. He was even kind enough to take pictures of not only my family but also my daughter. I didn't buy anything big today, just two handkerchiefs, but Mrs. Park gave me a small Korean handcrafted bosuk as a gift ❤️ I really had a great time thanks to Mrs. Park and her beautiful store 🥰

reviews.author: Seongwoo Park
reviews.text:
If you look at what this company claims, it says that if you purchase gold and store it in this company's safe, you can make a big profit because you can buy and sell gold without paying taxes, and they are actively advocating to purchase gold stored in a safe. However, this company is not a large company like the Korea Gold Exchange, but the same company as the local gold and silver store, but they only call it the gold exchange.
GBK, the gold bullion brand sold here, is not a brand of any great conglomerate or medium-sized company. It is just a gold bar made by a local gold and silver store-level company that commissioned small and medium-sized gold bullion producers.
In other words, the company that guarantees the quality of gold bars is the GBK Gold and Silver Room, and the quality of gold bars guaranteed by the Gold and Silver Room is not credible.
Also, this company is enticing people to buy gold by purchasing it and storing it in the company's safe instead of receiving it in kind, which is an act of quasi-receipt.
I don't know when this company will go bankrupt and disappear, and if this company disappears, I may or may not be able to recover the gold that was stored in the safe.
To make a profit from gold, you must purchase gold for at least 10 million won and wait for a period of years.
Can you make money by storing gold in a vault that is not a bank vault but that a small company like this claims to own?
This act of claiming to guarantee the principal and guarantee the profit is an act of quasi-receipt.
If this company goes bankrupt, it will go bankrupt and go bankrupt. At that time, you have to wonder whether it will be able to withdraw gold that is not stored in a safe that is not even there while it is busy preventing bankruptcy.
They say that the gold purchased by the buyer from this company will be stored in a safe held by this company, but in order to store gold in a safe, it must be held in physical gold.
But is it possible to store physical gold in a safe and not have to pay 10% VAT?
This is either complete tax evasion, or in fact, there is no physical gold to store in the safe, and I will simply issue you a deposit certificate saying that I am storing the gold you bought in the form of a promissory note.
This type of promissory note is often used by companies that have difficulty distributing operating funds, and since the credit rating of the promissory note is very low, the discount rate is extremely high.
Leaving the gold you bought from this company, which lures you by guaranteeing profits, should never be done, and if you do not need physical gold, there is a way to trade and invest in gold under the name of K-banking at a reliable Korea Exchange. It is much safer to invest in K-banking at the Korea Exchange, which will not go bankrupt unless the country goes bankrupt, rather than doing it at a local gold and silver company like this.
